objectives_fil: Sa role-play ni Liza, magtanong nang bukas, ibuod ang alalahanin at humingi ng pagwawasto nang walang panghuhusga.
objectives_en: In Liza’s role-play, ask an open question, summarize the concern and invite correction without judgment.

sections.takeaway_fil: Alamin ang alalahanin bago pumili ng tugon.
sections.takeaway_en: Find out the concern before choosing a response.

sections.takeaway_fil: Itanong ang alalahanin, makinig, ibuod at ipasuri ang pagkaintindi.
sections.takeaway_en: Ask about the concern, listen, summarize and check understanding.

sections.takeaway_fil: Inaanyayahan nitong magpaliwanag si Liza nang walang panghuhusga.
sections.takeaway_en: This invites Liza to explain without judgment.

check.prompt_fil: Malakas ang boses ni Liza. Aling sagot ni Jun ang makatutulong sa pagsisimula?
check.prompt_en: Liza raises her voice. Which reply helps Jun begin?

options.fil: “Ganito po talaga. Maghintay na lang kayo.”
options.en: “This is how it works. Just wait.”

options.fil: “Huwag po kayong magalit sa harap nila.”
options.en: “Please don’t get angry in front of them.”
“I would like to hear your concern.”

check.feedback_fil: 1: Isinasara nito ang usapan bago malinawan ang problema. 2: Nakatuon ito sa pagpigil sa damdamin sa harap ng iba, hindi sa pakikinig. 3: Inaanyayahan nitong magpaliwanag si Liza nang walang panghuhusga.
check.feedback_en: 1: This closes the conversation before the problem is clear. 2: This focuses on controlling emotion in public rather than listening. 3: This invites Liza to explain without judgment.

sections.takeaway_fil: Sa usapan kay Liza, gumamit ng mahinahong boses at bukas na tanong; hinayaang matapos ang sagot; ibinuod ito at humingi ng pagwawasto.
sections.takeaway_en: In the conversation with Liza, uses a calm voice and open question, lets her finish, summarizes her reply and invites correction.

sections.takeaway_fil: Humingi ng tulong sa tamang tao kapag lampas sa saklaw.
sections.takeaway_en: Seek the appropriate support when a situation exceeds your role.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ibinubuod nito ang narinig at humihingi ng pagwawasto.
sections.takeaway_en: This summarizes what was heard and invites correction.

check.prompt_fil: Sinabi ni Liza na hindi niya alam kung sino ang kakausapin. Ano ang susunod na sasabihin ni Jun?
check.prompt_en: Liza says she does not know whom to approach. What should Jun say next?

options.fil: “Ayaw po ba ninyong bumalik dahil matagal?”
options.en: “Do you refuse to return because it takes too long?”

options.fil: “Hindi pa malinaw ang contact. Tama po ba?”
options.en: “The contact is still unclear. Is that right?”

options.fil: “Sigurado po akong matatapos ito ngayong araw.”
options.en: “I am sure this will be finished today.”

check.feedback_fil: 1: Nagdadagdag ito ng motibo na hindi sinabi ni Liza. 2: Ibinubuod nito ang narinig at humihingi ng pagwawasto. 3: Nangangako ito ng resulta bago makumpirma ang magagawa ng staff.
check.feedback_en: 1: This adds a motive Liza did not state. 2: This summarizes what was heard and invites correction. 3: This promises an outcome before staff availability is confirmed.

sections.takeaway_fil: Pumili ng isang hakbang at balikan ang naging resulta.
sections.takeaway_en: Choose one action and follow up on the result.
